label: CPython fork
host: CPython 3.15.2 (fork_bench.py forks from a warm parent)
notes: The parent runs gc.collect() and gc.freeze(), as a zygote would, then forks children that write 1 + 1 to a pipe.
Memory: cgroup charge per child across 20 live children; USS 268.0 KiB, PSS 610.0 KiB. A child shares its parent's pages until it writes to them, so it grows as a script runs.
Start: median of 40 forks until the parent reads the answer.
Tool call and compute are not measured separately: a forked child runs the same interpreter as the CPython row.
